claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the products for making nails last long with little to no lifting.
Many customers report the items arrived well packaged with no leaks, spills, or breakage.
Several reviewers highlight good value, noting large bottle sizes and affordability for the quality.
A few customers mention missing instructions or being unsure how and when to use the products, especially as beginners.
A small number of reviews report receiving broken or damaged bottles, though at least one was resolved by the seller.
